## Problem

Describe the user or integration problem. Explain whether this is needed by Node.js, Docker, Electron, Vercel, Cloudflare, or another npm consumer.

## Proposed behavior

Describe the smallest public behavior or API change that would solve it.

## Compatibility

List any expected impact on existing routes, npm consumers, Node.js support, authentication state, or upstream QQ Music traffic.

Check the compatibility policy in `docs/compatibility.md`. Mention host or login-channel limitations and whether a migration would be needed.

## Alternatives

Describe workarounds or smaller alternatives you considered.

Use synthetic examples without credentials or personal data. Do not add third-party issue or pull-request cross-references without permission.
